Retired surface · Homepage

“Your son wouldn’t stop talking about space.”

The second of two “Everything connects” scenario panels on the Wizkoo homepage. Certified, deployed, and cut on 2026-08-02. This page is the complete record: the panel as it appeared in production, a working standalone render, and its verbatim source.

Cut date
2026-08-02
Reason
Space collision with the hero demo window. The hero already runs a space theme (“Maya, 6, exploring space”). Two space beats in one scroll undermine the infinite-range argument the “Everything connects” section exists to make.
Ruling reference
Ruled by Amy, 2026-08-02. Decision Registry — panel cut, turtle panel retained. The turtle panel (“Your daughter found a turtle in the backyard”) stays: found-object origin, the anti-curriculum proof.
Copy re-filed to
docs/copy-refile-son-space-panel.md — marked RE-FILED FOR: ESA pages / retargeting / social. All eight ruled strings preserved with lineage.
Replacement
A replacement son panel with a non-space theme is a separate future round. Copy goes through the Copy Room first. Not built here.
Photograph
assets/boy-rocket.jpg (70,376 bytes, 1200×800) — an unlicensed Stocksy comp, asset ID stocksy.com/7751997, watermark visible in frame at the deployed crop. Referenced by no other page; deleted with the cut. It survives only as the base64 embed on this page.
Cut from
index.html — markup at lines 2084–2121, styles at lines 577/580/585/588/ 597–609/629/634–636/643/650, nav hook at line 1716. Branch panel-cut, off excellence-round-1 at f7a55e9.

1 · As deployed

Full-bleed capture of the panel at viewport 1966×594, taken from the running site immediately before the cut. The panel box measured 1966×690 — taller than the viewport because @media(max-height:700px) and (min-width:768px) sets min-height:calc(100dvh + 96px). Scroll the frame sideways to read it at native width. This image is the authoritative visual record.

1966 × 690 px · 1,037,931 bytes · captured 2026-08-02

2 · Standalone render

The panel’s own markup and styles, frozen inline. No repo dependencies: the photograph is embedded as a data URI and every rule it needs is in this page’s stylesheet. Two deliberate deviations, both morgue-only: the runtime state class visible is pinned on (the live page adds it via IntersectionObserver, and without it every element sits at opacity:0), and the copy column’s 172px top padding — which reserved room for the site nav — is reduced to 56px. The verbatim source below is unaltered.

Everything connects

Your son wouldn’t stop talking about space.

Every subject just found its center of gravity.
Reading

The true story of the Apollo 11 mission.

Math

How far is the moon? Measure it in school buses.

Science

Why do astronauts float? What is gravity, really?

Atlas

Visit Kazakhstan. Find the launchpad where it all started.

Art

Paint the phases of the moon. Observe tonight, draw tomorrow.

Elementum

Helium: the element that lifts balloons and powers the sun.

Live render · resize the window to exercise its breakpoints

/* ═══ EVERYTHING CONNECTS ═══ */
.ec-section{padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink)}
.ec-inner{max-width:none;padding:0}
.ec-scenario{position:relative;min-height:80vh;overflow:hidden}
@keyframes kb-zoom{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.03)}}
.ec-col-photo{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.ec-photo-img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1);animation:kb-zoom 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.ec-scenario--turtle .ec-photo-img{object-position:center 55%}
.ec-scenario--space .ec-photo-img{object-position:center 30%}
.ec-scenario.visible .ec-photo-img{opacity:1}
.ec-col-photo::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.ec-scenario--space .ec-col-photo::after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 100% at 20% 50%,rgba(12,16,32,0.15) 0%,transparent 100%)}
.ec-scenario--turtle .ec-col-photo::after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 100% at 20% 50%,rgba(12,16,32,0.62) 0%,transparent 100%)}
.ec-col-copy{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:42%;height:100%;z-index:2;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;padding:172px 4% 0 7%}
.ec-eyebrow{font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 12px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1) .5s}

.ec-scenario--space .ec-headline{color:#0C1020}

@media(max-width:767px){
  .ec-scenario{height:auto;overflow:visible}

  .ec-proofs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,auto);grid-auto-flow:column;column-gap:8px;row-gap:4px}
  .ec-proof{margin-bottom:0}

  .ec-proof-body{font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;max-width:200px}
}
@media(max-height:700px) and (min-width:768px){
  .ec-scenario{min-height:calc(100dvh + 96px)}
  .ec-col-copy{padding:96px 4% 0 7%}
  .ec-eyebrow{margin:0 0 12px}
  .ec-headline{font-size:28px;margin:0 0 8px}
  .ec-kicker{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 16px}
  .ec-proof{margin-bottom:8px}
  .ec-proof-label{font-size:9px}
  .ec-proof-body{font-size:12px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .ec-photo-img{animation:none}
}
